detailZones.title: Optical head and eyepieces
detailZones.description: Inspect the binocular head, eyepieces, camera port, camera housing, support column and upper arm.

detailZones.title: Nosepiece, objectives and stage
detailZones.description: Follow the revolving nosepiece, four objective barrels, stage plate, slide holder and mechanical controls.

detailZones.title: Illumination and microscope base
detailZones.description: Explore the focus knobs, condenser, diaphragm, illuminator, base deck, feet, switch and power cable.

detailZones.title: Slide preparation and labware
detailZones.translation: 载玻片准备与实验器皿
detailZones.description: Inspect the colored slide tray, blank slides, forceps, pipette rack, clear tubes, dish and storage boxes.

detailZones.title: Computer, camera and bench support
detailZones.translation: 电脑、相机与实验台支持
detailZones.description: Follow the blank imaging monitor, keyboard, desk lamp, secondary microscope, bench shelving and drawers.

detailZones.title: Room, window and furnishings
detailZones.description: Inspect the window wall, glass partition, plants, stool, ceiling services, wall finish and floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized microscope-workstation photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable optical, mechanical, illumination, slide-preparation, computer, bench and room-fixture parts across 6 bounded zones. Specimen identity, diagnoses, disease claims, measurement readings, readable labels, brands, patient data and hidden microscope functions were excluded.
